labels: ESA WorldCereal 2021 v100 (10 m, Zenodo 7875105; CC-BY-4.0), majority class per 480 m patch
note: Unsupervised k-means (k=8, PCA-32) on Prithvi embeddings; each cluster is named after the majority WorldCereal class it overlaps. 'agreement' = share of labelled patches whose cluster name equals the WorldCereal majority class (labels are used to name clusters, so this is an agreement, not a held-out accuracy). 'accuracy' is a held-out logistic-regression probe on WorldCereal labels.
